what_happened: Two findings against the dispatch STATEMENT. (F1) ladderFrame's fwd hypothesis quantifies over the full carrier Q x N x N, but Rlad requires pend x.1 = false -> x.2.1 = 0, so an idle state with c = 1 has no successor, and if every state is pending (q,0,n) has none: fwd is unsatisfiable for every object, ladderFrame has never been instantiated (the ninth probe is generic over fwd/bwd), and ladderModel over ladderFrame cannot be built - Adm must be a carrier restriction. (F2) The stabilization statement over (c,n) >= |cl phi| is refuted on Q = Bool (pend = id, step total): the first idle after z carries n in [n-c-1, n+c+1], so n-c is observable via untl p (r and X(p and X r)), X := untl bot; cellAt (a,B,B+1) != cellAt (a,B,B+2); the past direction gives a second refutation (n < c-1 forces a pending-forever past, snce top r separates). Both the exhibited-B and exists-B forms fail. T1's positive verdict is one-region and never exercises n.

Both findings were machine-checked inside the research dispatch: prototype/ladder-cell-refutation-proto.lean (no_fwd, no_bwd_of_idle, cell_ne, exhibited_form_refuted, exists_form_refuted) compiles with 0 errors / 0 warnings in three guard-routed lake env lean rounds (~25 min), every headline theorem at [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound] or less, no sorryAx. The only tactic friction worth remembering: omega cannot see < on F.Duration (ascribe the untl witness as (s : Z), per the fixture's truth_Xp idiom), and full simp [Count] rewrites Nat casts inside hypotheses (use rw with Count-on-concrete-Bool lemmas instead).
